caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure of a person mounted on a small, square, gray platform with four round wheels. The figure has light brown skin and long black hair and wears a headdress with multiple tall, pointed feathers, which are colored in brown, gray, and hints of purple. The person is dressed in a brown tunic with puffed sleeves and a multilayered skirt adorned with patterned, feather-like embellishments in brown, lavender, and green. Green sashes are draped around the shoulders and waist, and a necklace of brown beads is worn around the neck. The figure's legs are covered with green and lavender patterned coverings that match the embellishments on the tunic. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or details present. The artist’s signature, “Ray Price,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
